g.text: Libo: displacement across cutoff and terrain roughness
30 shared spawns per rough group; one farthest-from-median complete 0–6 s observation omitted. Pale bars: sample SD.
Failures have no six-second score. Existing single flat control per wave has no repeat-based SD.
